level_patch.story: Four neighbours, one road, no time to wave traffic by hand.

callout.title: The booth is staffed
callout.body: Four neighbourhoods pour onto one road now. The booth ranks the queue for you, day and night. It is running the same card you chose last week — cards can be swapped any time, mid-week, no pause needed.

callout.title: Swap the rule, watch the road
callout.body: Open the booth and swap the card. Watch the road re-order itself the moment you do — the order of vehicles on the road IS the rule, laid out in the open.

callout.title: A card is a program
callout.body: Here is the whole text of the card you are running — one module, one line that ranks every vehicle. You can edit that line right here. Try ranking by what a vehicle asks for instead of when it arrived, and watch who starts swimming.

callout.title: You just wrote a kata
callout.body: That line is the entire language so far: rank by a key, the engine sorts by it. Everything you will automate this year is someone editing that key. The full editor is coming — you have already earned it.
